questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
options: Speed up to clear the intersection
questions.feedback: A flashing yellow light means proceed with caution. Be aware of intersecting traffic.

questions.question: What shape is a stop sign?
questions.feedback: A stop sign is an octagon (8-sided shape).

questions.question: In New York State, you must signal your turn at least how many feet before turning?
questions.feedback: You must signal your turn at least 100 feet before making the turn in NYS.
